tasks: Ceiling-Drilling Robot Set-Up: Set a ceiling-drilling robot to work on a concrete deck: scan the deck, set the barricade, switch the dust collection on, drill the layout and change a worn bit with the battery isolated. Hold the robot whenever a person steps inside the barricade.
